δέξο: δέχομαι — receive, accept; aor. imper. mid. 2 sg., epic -ξο (= Attic δέξαι): ’receive!’
δαμάσθη: δάμνημι (δαμάζω) — subdue, overpower; aor. 3 sg. pass., unaugmented (= Attic ἐδαμάσθη): ’was subdued’
δεύτατος: δεύτατος — last, hindmost; superl. adj. from δεύτερος ’second’ (Attic ὕστατος), masc. nom. sg.: ’last’
δοτῆρες: δοτήρ — giver, dispenser; masc. nom. pl., with a gen. of what is given: ’givers (of)’
εἶδ: ὁράω (aor. εἶδον) — see; aor. 3 sg., elided εἶδ’ = εἶδε: ’he saw’
εὐλὰς: εὐλή — maggot, worm; fem. acc. pl., object of a verb of breeding: ’maggots’
θυμοβόρῳ: θυμοβόρος — heart-devouring, gnawing at the spirit (θυμός + βιβρώσκω); adj. of two endings, dat. sg., agreeing with a fem. noun
θωρήσσεο: θωρήσσω — arm; mid. arm oneself; pres. imper. mid. 2 sg., epic -εο (= Attic θωρήττου): ’arm yourself!’
καδδῦσαι: καταδύω — sink down into, enter; aor. part. act. fem. nom. pl., κατά assimilated before δ (καδδ-; = Attic καταδῦσαι): ’having sunk down’
καλέσας: καλέω — call, summon; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having called’
κατέδουσιν: κατεσθίω — eat up, devour; pres. 3 pl., from the epic present κατέδω (= Attic κατεσθίουσιν): ’devour’
κεῖταί: κεῖμαι — lie, be laid; pres. subj. 3 sg. mid. dep., short-vowel epic subj. (= κέηται), after ἐάν: ’he lie’ · also pres. indic. 3 sg., accented before an enclitic: ’he lies’
κιόντες: κίω — go; pres. part. masc. nom. pl. (= Attic ἰόντες): ’going’
κυβερνῆται: κυβερνήτης — helmsman, steersman; masc. nom. pl., epic -ῆται as in Attic: ’helmsmen’
μένεσκον: μένω — stay, remain; impf. 3 pl., iterative -σκ- form, unaugmented (= Attic ἔμενον): ’used to stay’
μενεήναμεν: μενεαίνω — be eager, strain, rage; aor. 1 pl. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἐμενεήναμεν): ’we were eager’
μυίας: μυῖα — fly; fem. acc. pl., epic -ας (= Attic μυίας): ’flies’
μύρονθ: μύρομαι — weep, lament; impf. 3 pl. mid., elided μύρονθ’ = μύροντο, unaugmented (= Attic ἐμύροντο): ’they were lamenting’
νῶΐ: ἐγώ — I; 1st-person dual pronoun, nom. (acc. identical), epic νῶΐ (= Attic νώ): ’we two’
οἰήϊα: οἰήϊον — steering-oar, helm (= Attic οἴαξ); neut. acc. pl., epic -ϊα: ’steering-oars’
πειρήσω: πειράω — try, make an attempt; fut. 1 sg. act., epic -ήσω (= Attic πειράσω), + inf.: ’I shall try to…’
περικείμενον: περίκειμαι — lie around, lie over (+ dat.); pres. part. mid. dep., masc. acc. sg.: ’lying round’
σίτοιο: σῖτος — food, bread; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), dependent on a noun of giving: ’of food’
σαπήῃ: σήπω — make rot; pass. rot, decay; aor. 2 subj. 3 sg. pass., epic uncontracted -ήῃ (= Attic σαπῇ): ’it rot’
σκάζοντε: σκάζω — limp; pres. part. act. masc. nom. dual: ’the two limping’
στάξε: στάζω — let fall in drops, drip; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἔσταξε): ’dripped’
τέρπετο: τέρπω — delight; mid. take delight, enjoy; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= Attic ἐτέρπετο): ’took delight’
ταμίαι: ταμίας — steward, dispenser of stores; masc. nom. pl.: ’stewards’
τελεσφόρον: τελεσφόρος — bringing to completion, full (of a year’s cycle); adj. of two endings, masc. acc. sg.
τετάρπετο: τέρπω — delight; mid. take one’s fill, be satisfied; reduplicated aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= Attic ἐτέρφθη): ’took his pleasure’
φόρησεν: φορέω — carry, wear, bear; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἐφόρησεν): ’bore, has borne’
χαλκοτύπους: χαλκότυπος — struck with bronze, bronze-wrought (χαλκός + τύπτω); adj. of two endings, fem. acc. pl.
ἀλαλκεῖν: ἀλέξω — ward off, keep away; aor. 2 inf. act., reduplicated ἀλαλκεῖν, epic (cf. Attic ἀμῦναι): ’to ward off’
ἀνέβραχε: ἀναβράχω — crash out, ring out; aor. 3 sg. (ἀνά + ἔβραχε): ’rang out’
ἀολλίσθησαν: ἀολλίζω — gather together, assemble (Attic ἀθροίζω); aor. 3 pl. pass.: ’were gathered together’
ἀποειπὼν: ἀπεῖπον — speak out, declare, renounce (ἀπο- ’away’ + εἶπον ’say’); aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted ἀποειπών (= Attic ἀπειπών): ’having renounced’
ἀρηϊφάτους: ἀρηΐφατος — slain in war (Ἄρης + φένω); adj. of two endings, masc. acc. pl., epic (= Attic ἀρειφάτους): ’war-slain’
ἀσκελέως: ἀσκελής — dried-up, withered, hard; adv. ἀσκελέως, sense uncertain: ’stubbornly, without relenting’ is a guess from the context
ἀχνυμένω: ἄχνυμαι — grieve, be distressed; pres. part. mid., masc. nom. dual, agreeing with a dual pronoun: ’we two grieving’
ἐγγείνωνται: ἐγγείνομαι — breed in, engender in; aor. subj. 3 pl. mid., after μή: ’lest they breed’
ἐθέλωσ: ἐθέλω — be willing, wish; pres. subj. 3 pl. act., elided ἐθέλωσ’ = ἐθέλωσι, with αἴ κε: ’if they be willing’
ἐνιαυτόν: ἐνιαυτός — year; masc. acc. sg., after εἰς, of duration: ’for a year’
ἐνῆκε: ἐνίημι — send in, put into; aor. 3 sg. act. (κ-aorist), + acc.: ’put in’
ἐξεφάανθεν: ἐκφαίνω — show forth; pass. shine out, flash; aor. 3 pl. pass., epic -φάανθεν (= Attic ἐξεφάνησαν): ’flashed out’
ἐρειδομένω: ἐρείδω — prop, press; mid. lean (on + dat.); pres. part. mid., masc. nom. dual: ’the two leaning’
ἕλκεα: ἕλκος — wound, sore; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted -εα (= Attic ἕλκη)
ἰαύειν: ἰαύω — sleep, lie down to rest (= Attic καθεύδω); pres. inf. act.: ’to sleep’
ῥινῶν: ῥίς — nose; pl. nostrils; fem. gen. pl.: ’of the nostrils’ · also ῥινός — hide, skin; fem. gen. pl.: ’of hides’

__broaden__.μητέρα: μήτηρ — mother; fem. acc. sg., in apposition to Ἴτωνα · also fem. acc. sg., pendent object resumed by a pronoun: ’as for my mother’ (μητέρα … τὴν … ἀπέλυσε) · also fem. acc. sg., after ὑπό of motion: ’under (his) mother’ · also fem. acc. sg., person addressed after προσαυδάω: ’(spoke to) his mother’
__broaden__.ἄρειον: ἀρείων — better, stronger; comparative; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with τεῖχος: ’stronger’ · also neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’better’ (ἄρειον ἔπλετο ’was better’)
__broaden__.ἀθανάτων: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; gen. pl., as a noun, partitive: ’of the immortals’ · also adj., gen. pl. agreeing with a noun: ’immortal’ (ἀθανάτων … θεῶν ’of the immortal gods’) · also gen. pl. as a noun, predicate possessive: ’of the immortals’ (ἔργ’ ἔμεν ἀθανάτων ’to be works of the immortals’)
__broaden__.ἐμὴ: ἐμός — my, mine; fem. nom. sg., agreeing with ἲς: ’my’ · also fem. voc. sg., in address: ’my’ (μῆτερ ἐμή ’my mother’)
__broaden__.τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. nom./acc. sg. · in ὅ τι, ’whatever, why’ (= ὅτι) · also adverbial acc. with οὐ: ’at all’ (οὔ τι δυνήσεαι ’you will not at all be able’) · also adverbial acc. after εἰ: ’at all’ (εἴ ποτε δή τι … ὤνησας ’if ever you helped at all’) · also neut. acc. sg. with κακόν after μή: ’some’ (μή τι … ῥέξῃ κακὸν ’lest he do some evil’) · also adverbial acc. after μή: ’at all’ (μή τι διατρίβειν ’not to delay at all’) · also neut. acc. sg., object of πάσχω after μή: ’any (harm)’ (μή τι πάθοι ’lest he suffer any harm’) · also adverbial acc. after αἴ κεν: ’somehow’ (αἴ κέν τι … γένηαι ’if somehow you become’) · also adverbial acc. after οὐδέ, with a partitive gen.: ’at all’ (οὐδέ τι τῶν μέμνηται ’nor does he remember any of it’) · also adverbial acc. after οὐδέ, with no partitive: ’at all’ (οὐδέ τι τίει ’does not honour at all’) · also neut. sg., agreeing with μῆχος after οὐδέ: ’any’ (οὐδέ τι μῆχος ’nor any means’) · also adverbial acc. after μήτε: ’at all’ (μήτέ τι νείκει ’nor find fault at all’) · also adverbial acc. with a comparative: ’somewhat’ (τι … ἄμεινον ’somewhat better’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with σπέος: ’a certain’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ὄφελος: ’some’ (ὄφελός τι ’some use’) · also adverbial acc. in a question after ἠέ: ’at all’ (ἠέ τι βέβληαι ’have you been hit at all’) · also neut. acc. sg., object after εἰ: ’anything’ (εἴ τι … ῥέξει ’if … will do anything’) · also adverbial acc. in a question after ἦ ἄρ: ’at all, in any way’ (ἦ ἄρ τι … ἄρειον ’was it in any way better?’)
__broaden__.ἐρυθρὸν: ἐρυθρός — red; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with νέκταρ: ’red’
__broaden__.πρώτῃ: πρῶτος — first; adj., fem. dat. sg., agreeing with ὑσμίνῃ: ’in the first (fight)’ · also fem. dat. sg., agreeing with ἀγορῇ after μετά: ’first’
__broaden__.ἕλον: αἱρέω — take; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic εἷλον); ἐκ … ἕλον in tmesis ’picked out’ · also aor. 1 sg. (same -ον ending): ’I took away’ · also in battle: ’killed’ (ἕλον ἄνδρα ’killed a man’) · also aor. 3 pl. with ὀδάξ: ’bit’ (ὀδὰξ ἕλον οὖδας ’bit the ground’)
__broaden__.δαίδαλα: δαίδαλον — intricate work, finely wrought thing; neut. acc. pl. · also neut. nom. pl., in apposition to the subject: ’intricate works’ (δαίδαλα πάντα)
__broaden__.βλεφάρων: βλέφαρον — eyelid; neut. gen. pl., after κατά: ’down from the eyelids’ · also neut. gen. pl., after ὑπό: ’from under the eyelids’
__broaden__.μὴν: μήν — truly, indeed; affirmative particle, in εἰ δ’ ἄγε μὴν ’come now’ · also καὶ μὴν, ’yes, and, moreover’, adding a further item
__broaden__.μενεαινέμεν: μενεαίνω — be eager, rage, be furious; pres. inf. act., epic -έμεν (= Attic -ειν), standing for an imperative after μηδέ · also pres. inf. act. after χρή, with a negative: ’to be eager’
__broaden__.αὐτῶν: αὐτός — self; gen. pl. as the plain personal pronoun after a preposition: ’them’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῶν ’on them’) · also gen. pl. dependent on a noun, ’of them’ (ἄνυσις … αὐτῶν ’accomplishment of them’) · also intensive, gen. pl. agreeing with a noun: ’of the men themselves’ (ποδῶν αὐτῶν τε καὶ ἵππων ’of the very men’s feet and of the horses’) · also gen. pl. standing alone for the men, as against their horses: ’of the men themselves’ (αὐτῶν ἠδ’ ἵππων ’of the men and of the horses’) · also intensive, gen. pl. with a pronoun: τῶν … αὐτῶν ’of those very men’ · also gen. pl. plain pronoun governed by ἀντίον: ’them’ (ἀντίον … αὐτῶν ’face to face with them’) · also gen. pl. plain pronoun governed by σχεδόν: ’them’ (σχεδὸν … αὐτῶν ’close to them’) · also intensive, gen. pl. with καί, dependent on a noun: ’their own’ (καὶ αὐτῶν θυμός ’their own heart, too’) · also plain pronoun, gen. pl. after ἀήθεσσον: ’them’ (ἀήθεσσον … αὐτῶν ’unused to them’) · also intensive, gen. pl. with σφῶν: ’of themselves’ (σφῶν τ’ αὐτῶν ’of themselves’) · also gen. pl. standing for the men as against the ships: ’of the men themselves’ (νηῶν τε καὶ αὐτῶν ’of the ships and of the men themselves’) · also gen. pl. partitive, with an indefinite pronoun: ’of them’ (τιν’ … αὐτῶν ’some of them’)
